description: This file contains the definition of the 'Success' controller class within the OpenCart catalog account namespace. It manages the display of the account success page after a transaction or order completion, including setting breadcrumbs, page title, loading various page components, and generating the final view output.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: Controller class for handling the account success page, extending the core engine controller and implementing logic for rendering the success message and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method invoked to generate and display the success page. It loads language resources, sets the page title, constructs breadcrumb navigation, loads common layout components, and outputs the final view.
